ForceEndFlag.description_en: Specifies whether to forcibly end the task at its scheduled completion time. If enabled, the task is marked as `Finished` at the scheduled time, even if not all numbers have been called. This is useful for scenarios with strict call time windows. RetryStrategy.description_en: The retry strategy. In Basic Mode, the value is a JSON object with a structure like `{"retry":2,"strategy":[{"round":1,"time":"1-1-1"},{"round":2,"time":"2-2-2"}]}`. In this structure, `retry` is the number of retries, `round` is the retry attempt number, and `time` is the retry interval in D-H-M (Day-Hour-Minute) format. In Advanced Mode, which is available only for automated outbound call tasks with the Number Status Recognition service enabled, the value is a JSON array with a structure like `[{"condition":{"sipCause":[710,719]},"retry":1,"sort":1,"strategy":[{"round":1,"time":"0-0-10"}]},{"condition":{"sipCause":[800]},"retry":1,"sort":2,"strategy":[{"round":2,"time":"0-0-10"}]}]`. In this structure, `condition` specifies the retry condition, `sort` specifies the priority of the condition, and the remaining fields are the same as in Basic Mode
RetryStrategy.description_zh: 重试策略，「基础模式」数据结构为Json格式```{"retry":2,"strategy":[{"round":1,"time":"1-1-1"},{"round":2,"time":"2-2-2"}]}```格式说明：retry是重试次数，round是第几次重试，time是第几次重试间隔的时间：1-1-1，第一个1是天，第二个1是小时，第三个1是分钟「高级模式」高级模式需要开启「号码状态识别」服务后。目前只支持「自动外呼」任务模式。数据结构为JsonArray格式 ```[{"condition":{"sipCause":[710,719]},"retry":1,"sort":1,"strategy":[{"round":1,"time":"0-0-10"}]},{"condition":{"sipCause":[800]},"retry":1,"sort":2,"strategy":[{"round":2,"time":"0-0-10"}]}]```格式说明：condition是重试条件，sort是重试条件的顺序，其余字段与基础模式一致
RetryStrategy.title_en: 重试策略，「基础模式」数据结构为Json格式```{"retry":2,"strategy":[{"round":1,"time":"1-1-1"},{"round":2,"time":"2-2-2"}]}```格式说明：retry是重试次数，round是第几次重试，time是第几次重试间隔的时间：1-1-1，第一个1是天，第二个1是小时，第三个1是分钟「高级模式」高级模式需要开启「号码状态识别」服务后。目前只支持「自动外呼」任务模式。数据结构为JsonArray格式 ```[{"condition":{"sipCause":[710,719]},"retry":1,"sort":1,"strategy":[{"round":1,"time":"0-0-10"}]},{"condition":{"sipCause":[800]},"retry":1,"sort":2,"strategy":[{"round":2,"time":"0-0-10"}]}]```格式说明：condition是重试条件，sort是重试条件的顺序，其余字段与基础模式一致
